post.name: EU passes new directive mandating user-replaceable batteries and modular designs in all electronics
post.body: The European Parliament has overwhelmingly approved the Ecodesign regulations requiring standardized fastener access and 5-year spare parts availability.

post.name: Self-hosted alternative to major streaming platforms reaches 1.0 with P2P mesh relay support
post.body: OpenStream 1.0 brings end-to-end encrypted live broadcasting with decentralized relay nodes.
